title: The Door
summary: An outbreak traps a father, his daughter and Danny, an exchange student, aboard a train to Busan. As the infected overrun the cars, Danny reaches the driver’s cab and gets the train moving while the others hold the doors. Their escape becomes a story of sacrifice: the men who protect the group take the wounds that will cost them their lives.

scenes.4: The barricade fails — and the run to the front

shots.title: First light of the platform
shots.description: static wide from ON THE PLATFORM, camera outside the train at eye level: a KTX carriage stopped along the right of frame with one door standing open, a line of Korean commuters waiting on the platform facing that open door, the terminal's tall glass wall and morning city light behind them. We are not inside the train — no carriage interior, no seats in the foreground
shots.action: commuters board in soft morning light

shots.title: The students spill on
shots.description: four Korean-American exchange students in their twenties spilling loudly through a train door, laughing, backpacks swinging, morning light behind them
shots.action: students spill on loud and laughing

shots.title: Half a beat behind them
shots.description: a 25-year-old Vietnamese-American man alone just inside a train door, backpack on one shoulder, lips moving silently as he rehearses a phrase, the group already gone ahead of him
shots.action: Danny drifts in a beat behind, mouthing a phrase

shots.title: The father and daughter board
shots.description: a tieless charcoal-suited man walking a smaller figure in a red cardigan onto the train, one hand resting on her shoulder, his eyes already somewhere else
shots.action: Seok-woo boards with Soo-an, eyes elsewhere

shots.title: The last one aboard
shots.description: past the students' shoulders on the platform as they laugh, far down the carriage a woman alone stepping up through the last door, a jacket held closed over one forearm, head down, not looking at anyone; she is small and soft in the depth of frame and nobody registers her
shots.action: she boards last, alone, hiding an arm

shots.title: Push in through the door frame
shots.description: shot through the open train-door frame, shallow focus on teal-green seats inside, blurred faces sliding past the frame edge
shots.action: faces slide past through the door frame

shots.title: She answers him
shots.description: a young woman in her twenties in university-casual layers with a canvas backpack leaning back from a teal train seat toward a man standing in the aisle, grinning, correcting him; he is caught mid-sentence, embarrassed, morning light through the big side windows
shots.action: cut — she answers him

shots.title: The seat she saves
shots.description: a young woman's hand flat on the empty teal seat beside her, patting it twice without looking up, a man's blurred shoulder entering frame to take it, warm window light
shots.action: cut — the seat she saves

shots.title: The man who takes the weight
shots.description: a burly broad-shouldered Korean man in a dark work shirt with the sleeves pushed up and both forearms wrapped in yellow tape, reaching past a smaller passenger to push a heavy case up onto the overhead rack for her, one-handed, then dropping into his own seat without waiting to be thanked; across the aisle a smaller figure in a red cardigan has stopped to watch him
shots.action: he lifts a stranger's case onto the rack and sits back down

shots.title: Two rows back
shots.description: over the young woman's shoulder as she turns back to her seat, and soft in the background two rows behind her a passenger sitting very upright, both hands locked on the armrests, sweat at her hairline, jaw set, staring at nothing
shots.action: she is sweating and gripping the armrests

shots.title: Seated, the recital ask
shots.description: two-shot across a teal train seat, the red cardigan turned up toward the man in the aisle seat, bright window daylight
shots.action: she looks up at him, hopeful

shots.title: His answer, without looking
shots.description: CU on the aisle-seat man, phone low in his hands, eyes down on it, answering without lifting them; the red cardigan stays in her window seat just past his shoulder at the edge of frame, soft. He does not change seats. Cool window light
shots.action: he answers without looking up

shots.title: The call he takes
shots.description: a tieless charcoal-suited man rising from a teal train seat with a phone already at his ear, one hand raised in a wait-there gesture toward the seat he is leaving, moving away down the aisle with his back to it; the empty seat beside her stays in frame as he goes
shots.action: he takes a call and walks away from her

shots.title: Her hand on the armrest
shots.description: tight insert on a hand gripping a teal armrest, knuckles bloodless, the veins under the skin running dark up the wrist, and at the cuff a dressing gone through, bright daylight across it
shots.action: the edge of a dressing shows at her cuff

shots.title: The car at speed, ordinary
shots.description: wide interior of a Korean KTX carriage at cruise, one-point straight down the centre aisle: rows of teal-green fabric seats with pale headrest covers either side, Korean commuters reading and dozing in them, overhead luggage racks, the wood-panelled end bulkhead and its door at the far end, bright daylight sliding across the ceiling and landscape streaking past the windows
shots.action: the ordinary carful, seconds before

shots.title: The cough that will not stop
shots.description: a Korean woman in her early thirties gone rigid in a teal train seat, head tipped back against the headrest, chin lifted, both hands closed hard on the armrests with the tendons showing, one heel off the floor, damp hair stuck at her temple; three or four passengers in the rows around her have turned to look, one half standing; bright window daylight against hard cold ceiling fluorescents
shots.action: she doubles forward into a hard dry coughing fit she cannot stop, one hand groping for the armrest; the coughing turns wet and chokes off, and her whole body locks rigid against the seat back — a fine tremor starting in her hands and running up her arms

shots.title: The eyes
shots.description: extreme CU on a Korean woman's eyes, the colour drained out of the irises to a flat pale grey-blue, unfocused and aimed at nothing past the lens, lashes wet, a sheen of sweat on the skin at the temple and the bridge of the nose, everything beyond her thrown soft, cold overhead light
shots.action: the colour drains out of her irises from the pupil outward until both eyes are a flat milky blue-white film, still open, still aimed at nothing

shots.title: She loses the body and comes for him
shots.description: a Korean woman in her early thirties rising out of a teal train seat in one unbroken motion that is slightly too fast, weight already forward, head tipped over at an angle her neck should not hold, jaw slack, breathing hard through an open mouth, hands hanging loose and turned the wrong way at the wrists; the passengers on either side pull back into their seats
shots.action: the tremor takes her whole body and she loses control of it — she comes up out of the seat in one wrong unbroken motion, head tipped at an angle her neck should not hold, hangs there a beat finding her balance, then starts across the aisle toward the seated man on a lurching, uneven walk, one shoulder leading

shots.title: She takes the man across the aisle
shots.description: a pale-eyed woman in her thirties come down onto a seated male passenger, both her hands gripping his shoulders, her open mouth clamped hard onto the side of his neck above the collar, her hair fallen forward across his jaw; his head wrenched back and away from her, eyes squeezed shut, mouth open, both his hands up and pushing at her shoulder and her forehead; dark red running from under her mouth down into his shirt collar
shots.action: she reaches him, takes him by both shoulders and drives her open mouth into the side of his neck above the collar

shots.title: It registers on his face
shots.description: hard CU on the same seated man from the shot before, turning to the lens the instant she comes off him: eyes wide and fixed, mouth open on a sound we do not hear yet, the tendons standing in his throat, one hand clamped to the side of his collar with dark red between the fingers, cold ceiling light on damp skin
shots.action: his hand goes to his collar and comes away marked

shots.title: One-point down the aisle
shots.description: one-point perspective straight down a teal KTX aisle, seat-backs slicing the frame either side and overhead racks converging, the same woman from the seat coming at the camera at a flat run down the centre of it, arms loose and swinging wide, mouth open, hair off her face, pale-eyed, everything behind her smeared with speed under cold fluorescents
shots.action: she comes down the aisle at the camera at a flat run

shots.title: The car erupts
shots.description: passengers scrambling over teal seat-backs away from camera, bags flying, an exchange student half-turned back shouting
shots.action: the passengers get up all at once and go the other way

shots.title: The only one standing up
shots.description: in a teal train aisle full of people getting up and pushing the other way, one burly broad-shouldered man with yellow-taped forearms rising out of his seat AGAINST the flow, turning to face down the carriage, blurred bodies streaming past him either side, cold fluorescent over daylight
shots.action: he stands up and turns toward the far end of the car

shots.title: Danny, the only one not moving
shots.description: locked wide straight down a teal train aisle: passengers surging past camera in motion blur, bags and coats streaking, and at the far end of the aisle one young man standing completely still against the glass vestibule door — sharp while everything around him is smeared, arms at his sides, watching. He is the only thing in focus and the only thing not moving
shots.action: the panic goes past him and he does not move

shots.title: The strongman moves
shots.description: a burly broad-shouldered man planting himself square in a train aisle, one arm swept back and low behind him, the red cardigan tucked in close behind his hip and half hidden by his body, motion blur past them both, cold light
shots.action: he plants himself in the aisle and puts her behind him

shots.title: The father, too far
shots.description: down a chaotic train aisle from the far end: a tieless charcoal-suited man shoving forward against a wall of bodies going the other way, phone gone, arm out toward something he cannot reach, faces streaming past between him and the lens
shots.action: he fights toward her and cannot get through

shots.title: Torn away
shots.description: the red cardigan close behind a grown man's back, her face turned out past his arm to look down the aisle, mouth open, everything past her thrown out of focus
shots.action: she looks out past his arm, down the aisle

shots.title: Survivors jam one car
shots.description: a teal-green train car packed with pressed-together survivors, bodies against seat-backs, breathing, deep shadow with one cold pool of light
shots.action: survivors jam into one car

shots.title: Danny in the crush
shots.description: packed shoulder to shoulder in near-darkness among pressed-together survivors, one young man wedged between them, eyes fixed on the wedged door ahead, breathing shallow, saying nothing while everyone around him whispers
shots.action: he says nothing, again

shots.title: She finds him in the dark
shots.description: in the packed dark carriage, the young woman in the university layers wedged three bodies along from the young man in the navy coat, her head turned to find him, one small nod when she does; he does not nod back, one cold pool of light across the pressed-together faces between them
shots.action: she looks for him in the crush and finds him

shots.title: The door is wedged
shots.description: close on hands forcing a train door shut and wedging a metal latch, knuckles white, near-black teal
shots.action: hands wedge the door shut

shots.title: The businessman, hissing
shots.description: a grey-haired Korean executive in a pinstripe suit crouched low against a train seat, hissing upward at the others, face half in shadow
shots.action: the businessman hisses them down

shots.title: The strongman, low
shots.description: a burly Korean man crouched in a dark train aisle, one finger raised, speaking barely above a breath
shots.action: the strongman warns them quiet

shots.title: He almost speaks
shots.description: a young man's face in a dark train car opening his mouth to say something, drawing breath — and stopping, eyes cutting sideways to a grey-haired man out of focus in the foreground, jaw closing again, one cold pool of light across half his face
shots.action: he starts to speak and stops

shots.title: The held wide
shots.description: static wide of a packed teal train car in near-darkness, survivors pressed together along the seats and standing in the aisle, nobody moving, a faint teal rim on every face — the young man in the navy coat among them against the far seat backs, the suited man and the red cardigan low in a seat mid-frame, held
shots.action: held silence — nobody moves

shots.title: Rack focus to the window
shots.description: rack focus from the survivors' faces in the dark carriage — the young man in the navy coat nearest the lens — through to the black train window behind them, where pale-eyed reflections layer over their own
shots.action: white-eyed reflections layer over their faces

shots.title: The girl, whispering
shots.description: the red cardigan pressed against the suited man's chest in near-darkness, whispering, only her eyes catching light
shots.action: she whispers that she is scared

shots.title: His answer, close
shots.description: CU, near-darkness: the tieless charcoal-suited man, lips parted an inch from the held figure's hair and stirring a few loose strands with each breathed word; one hand splayed flat across her back, the other cupped at the base of her skull pressing her cheek into his lapel, her weight slumped into his chest; his collar gone dark and wet where the stain has soaked through the cloth.
shots.action: lips moving against her hair, one hand flat on her back, one cradling her skull

shots.title: The slam
shots.description: a body slamming hard against a black train window from outside, palms and face flattened on the glass, and inside the dark carriage the young man in the navy coat recoiling back from it into the seat behind him, other survivors pulling away either side of him
shots.action: something heavy hits the glass from the far side

shots.title: The car under siege
shots.description: wide straight down the length of the teal carriage — every seat empty and the whole car on its feet: survivors crushed standing into the aisle and wedged down into the gaps between the rows, shoulders turned in, heads dropped below the seat-back line, coats and hard cases stacked waist-high across the far connecting doorway. That end door is shut on a case jammed under its runner and it is walking a hand's width open and back again, hands and faces flattened along the glass in the gap
shots.action: nobody is seated — the car is standing and crushed away from the door while the wedge under it walks open and back

shots.title: The pane goes
shots.description: the sliding glass end door seen straight on from inside the carriage, the pane gone white all over with a spider of cracks out of one corner — and hard up against the far side of that glass, filling every part of it, faces and open hands and shoulders packed flat and sliding on the pane, so many that no floor and no ceiling shows behind them; the chromed lever still seated in its plate and the whole sheet bowed inward off its runner
shots.action: the crazed pane bows inward, packed solid on the far side

shots.title: The car goes
shots.description: one-point down the aisle of the teal carriage on a long lens, and the car is in motion: every person out of the seats and up on their feet, mid-stride, turned away from the lens with arms out for the seat-backs as they go, coats and bags left behind on the cushions, the aisle a solid column of moving backs — and at the top of frame, coming the other way through the connecting doorway, the front rank stumbling over each other's heels
shots.action: everyone is up and moving away; the two columns close on each other mid-car

shots.title: The businessman
shots.description: floor-level down the aisle between two rows of teal seats: a grey-haired man in his fifties in a pinstripe suit flat on his back on the carpet with his burst briefcase and its papers spilled under him, and one figure lying full length on top of him chest to chest, its hands fisted in his lapels and its face down at his throat — both his own hands driven up flat under its jaw, his heels scrabbling the carpet for purchase, and a second pair of legs stepping over the two of them without stopping
shots.action: one of them is full length on top of him on the floor; he has both hands under its jaw

shots.title: He puts her behind him
shots.description: the tieless suited man turning side-on in the aisle with one hand flat on the back of the smaller figure in the red cardigan, walking her back between two teal seat-backs and folding her down out of the aisle behind him, his own eyes already up and forward past the lens, the hard ceiling light catching only the edge of his jaw
shots.action: he folds her down out of the aisle behind him and his eyes come up forward

shots.title: The father tapes up
shots.description: the tieless suited man standing in the aisle in his charcoal jacket, right arm held out and the sleeve pushed back, winding a strip of yellow tape round his own knuckles and down over the wrist, his eyes not on his hands but forward down the car, teal seat-backs running away behind him
shots.action: he winds yellow tape round his knuckles without looking at them

shots.title: The train dies
shots.description: the length of the teal carriage at seat-back height as everything slows, the rows empty and figures braced standing in the aisle — the black windows down one side going from a smear to a still line of dark countryside, the overhead strips dropping out one bank at a time until only the low floor-level runners are lit, coats and a bag sliding forward along the empty aisle and coming to rest against a seat leg
shots.action: the windows stop smearing, the ceiling banks drop out, loose things slide forward and stop

shots.title: Go forward
shots.description: the burly man in the dark work shirt in the near ground half-turned back over his shoulder, one taped arm thrown out straight past his own body and away down the length of the car, his mouth wide on a shout and the cords standing in his neck — and at the edge of frame the young man in the navy coat already turning that way, his shoulder dropping into the first step, the low floor runners throwing everything upward
shots.action: he throws one arm down the car toward the front and the young man is already turning

shots.title: The run to the front
shots.description: the young man in the navy coat running straight at the lens down the middle of a dark connecting corridor, both arms pumping and his coat flying open back off his shoulders, one hand skimming the wall for the turn, the low floor runners throwing light up under his chin and the corridor falling away behind him into black
shots.action: he runs the length of the cars toward the front

shots.title: The two of them
shots.description: the narrow aisle of the teal carriage head-on from the far end: the burly man in the dark work shirt filling the passage nearest the lens with both taped forearms up, and the tieless suited man tight in beside him with one shoulder wedged against the seat-backs and his taped knuckles raised at his own jaw — two men in a passage only wide enough for one, lit from below off the floor runners, the length of the car black behind them
shots.action: the two of them wedge the passage shoulder to shoulder

shots.title: The strongman takes it
shots.description: the burly man from behind and slightly above, one taped forearm still braced across a figure's chest and his own head wrenched hard away to the far side, while a second face is in close at the join of his neck and shoulder with its open mouth clamped down on the dark work shirt there — his free hand already coming up flat into that one's temple, dark spreading out through the cloth from under its jaw
shots.action: one gets in at the join of his neck and shoulder; he brings his free hand up flat into its temple

shots.title: The console
shots.description: the young man in the navy coat alone in the driver's cab, both hands spread on the console under the forward glass, head down over a row of unmarked switches, one short lever half pulled and set back — then his right fist closed round the tall master handle at the console's edge, the long empty track running out ahead into the dark past the windscreen
shots.action: he tries one lever, sets it back, reads the console, and takes the master handle

shots.title: The father takes it
shots.description: the tieless suited man with his taped left forearm driven in crossways under a figure's chin, its open mouth closed hard on the bare arm just above the tape, his own face turned away and his teeth set, his right hand flat under its jaw and levering its head back off him — dark running down the inside of that sleeve toward the elbow
shots.action: it closes on his left forearm above the tape; his right hand levers its head back off him

shots.title: The train takes
shots.description: over the young man's shoulder in the driver's cab as the view through the forward glass starts to move — the two rails running out ahead going from still to sliding, the reach of the headlamp opening up along them, his knuckles pale on the master handle and his shoulders coming down off his ears
shots.action: the rails ahead go from still to sliding

shots.title: What is left of the car
shots.description: high wide down the length of the teal carriage from ceiling height: most of the rows empty, coats and bags and single shoes scattered the length of the aisle floor, a few shapes still moving between seats at the far end, and in the near third two figures backing toward the connecting doorway with a smaller figure in a red cardigan and a young woman ahead of them — and along the whole side of the car the black windows sliding again
shots.action: the emptied car, moving again, and the two of them backing toward the connecting door

shots.title: The corridor
shots.description: low-angle looming shot craning up at the broad-shouldered man wedged in the narrow train corridor — boots set wide across the aisle, knees bent, weight dropped low over them, shoulders squared flat to the lens and chin tucked down toward the camera, bare arms hanging out from his sides where both forearms are slicked dark and wet, the stain running unbroken to fingertips that drip onto the floor, his bulk filling the frame
shots.action: he sets his boots wide and drops his weight, dark-slicked arms hanging, blocking the aisle

shots.title: The order
shots.description: a burly Korean man half-turned back over his shoulder toward a suited man behind him, shouting, corridor dark beyond
shots.action: he orders them to the front car

shots.title: The refusal
shots.description: CU of the tieless charcoal-suited man, a dark stain spreading through the cloth at his collar, mouth open mid-word and jaw pushed forward, one hand rising open toward someone off-frame while his heels stay planted and his weight braces back against the pull — held in low warm-cool light
shots.action: hand rising open, heels planted, weight braced back against the off-frame pull

shots.title: Danny takes the front
shots.description: the young man in the navy coat first through a dark connecting door, hauling it back on its runner and holding it open with his body as the others come through past him — the young woman, the suited man carrying the red cardigan — his eyes going back down the corridor behind them
shots.action: he holds the connecting door while the others get through

shots.title: Take her
shots.description: a burly man not looking back, eyes forward down a dark corridor, speaking over his shoulder, the red cardigan blurred behind him
shots.action: he refuses without turning

shots.title: They pour in
shots.description: Infected jam into the narrow train corridor shoulder to shoulder, the front rank stumbling over each other's heels, hands scrabbling along both walls, lurching toward a lone broad-shouldered man wedged across the passage — feet planted wide, one shoulder driven forward, both palms flat against opposite walls — their irises drained to a flat pale grey-blue and unfocused; the corridor near-black but for one cold pool of light.
shots.action: infected jam through the gap over each other's heels, hands scrabbling the walls toward him

shots.title: Camera retreats as he goes under
shots.description: receding shot down a dark train corridor: deep at the far end a knot of figures converges on the lone man — hands clamp his arms and collar, bodies press shoulder to shoulder and drive him down, their backs sealing the gap until nothing of him shows, only packed bodies where he stood; in the foreground three people hurry away from camera, the young woman in the university layers twisting her head back over her shoulder toward the far vestibule before a hand at her arm pulls her on
shots.action: hands clamp the man and the bodies press shut over him as the others keep walking

shots.title: The line is blocked
shots.description: through the forward glass of the driver's cab, the tunnel mouth opening ahead onto dusk-lit open country — and lying side-on across both rails just beyond it, the flank of a toppled train, carriages folded off the line at an angle with one end lifted clear of the ballast, fire working along the underside and lighting the smoke standing over it; close, and closing fast, the young man in the navy coat a dark shape against the glass in the near ground
shots.action: the headlamp finds a toppled train lying side-on across both rails

shots.title: Everything he has on the brake
shots.description: the young man in the navy coat side-on in the driver's cab, both hands closed round the tall master handle and pulling it all the way back into his hip, shoulders up round his ears, one boot braced flat against the console base and his whole weight hanging off the lever, his face turned to the forward glass and lit orange by what is coming
shots.action: he pulls the master handle back with his whole weight, one boot braced on the console

shots.title: Overhead, the wreck
shots.description: high vulnerable overhead of a jackknifed high-speed train off its line in open countryside, tilted teal carriages, steel dust haze and firelight halation at dusk
shots.action: the KTX jackknifes off the line

shots.title: Survivors crawl out, and she counts
shots.description: survivors dragging themselves out of a toppled carriage into teal-steel dust, the young woman in the torn university layers up first, turning on the spot scanning the bodies coming out — and stopping when the young man in the navy coat comes over the sill after her, dust-grey and holding his ribs
shots.action: forearms haul limp bodies over the carriage sill

shots.title: He finds her
shots.description: a tieless suited man dropping to both knees in the drifting smoke, weight pitched forward, dark wet staining spread across his white collar and smeared down one cheek, both hands cupped over the cheeks of the small child in the red cardigan, thumbs pressed along her jaw, her face tilted up into his, firelight catching the edge of them
shots.action: the suited man drops to his knees and cups the red-cardigan child's face in the smoke

shots.title: She coughs
shots.description: CU of a soot-marked red cardigan, its wearer coughing and shaking her head, dust in her hair, warm dusk light
shots.action: she coughs and says she is okay

shots.title: The tunnel mouth
shots.description: two-shot at a concrete tunnel mouth in firelight halation, the suited man down on one knee at the red cardigan's eye level, one hand braced on his thigh and his head tilted down to hers, a dark stain spread across his shirtfront and low on one lapel, the cloth wet and clinging where it meets his collar, near-black beyond them
shots.action: the suited man kneels to the red cardigan's eye level, shirtfront dark and wet

shots.title: The wound he hides
shots.description: CU of fingers dragging the cuff down the forearm, the cloth darkening wet as it crosses a curved arc of torn punctures still beading dark, his other hand pressed flat and still on his knee, firelight raking across the wet skin
shots.action: fingers drag the cuff down over the punctured forearm

shots.title: Look at me
shots.description: CU: the left side of the man's jaw and collar dark and wet where the stain has spread through the cloth, both his hands cupping the sides of the face in front of him — fingers spread flat over her cheeks, thumbs pressing up under her chin — drawing her head slowly around, her chin lifting, until her face rotates to meet his; firelight haloing the two of them from behind
shots.action: he draws her face around to meet his

shots.title: The instruction
shots.description: the same CU two-shot held, the man speaking level and calm, the smaller face listening, warm firelight, near-black beyond
shots.action: he gives her the counting instruction

shots.title: She asks
shots.description: CU of the red cardigan reaching for a man already standing out of frame, her hand closing on nothing
shots.action: she reaches for him

shots.title: The lie
shots.description: over the shoulder of the smaller figure in the red cardigan walking away from us into the tunnel, soft and dark in the near ground filling the left of frame — and past her, sharp, the suited man half-turned back toward the firelight with one hand up and open waving her on, mouth open on a word aimed at her back, his rear foot already lifted and set down behind him, a dark stain spread wet across his side; the black of the tunnel behind him swallowing the edge of his shoulder
shots.action: he waves her on and takes his first step back into the dark

shots.title: And the one who knows what it costs
shots.description: the frame holding on her face as a figure recedes backward out of focus into black behind her, firelight dying, held silence — and past her shoulder, soft, the young man in the navy coat watching the dark take him, recognising it
shots.action: he walks backward into the dark

shots.title: Long lens down the tunnel
shots.description: long lens straight down a dark concrete tunnel toward a blown-out daylight mouth, three silhouettes walking up toward it — a smaller one between two taller — everything else near-black
shots.action: the two walk toward the light

shots.title: Their hands find each other
shots.description: waist-level from behind and low in the tunnel, three pairs of legs walking away up the concrete toward the blown-out daylight — in the middle the red cardigan, her arms lifting out to both sides; on her left a young woman in torn university layers with a canvas backpack, her hand closing down over the small one; on her right the young man in the navy coat, his hand closing over the other — fingers folding through fingers, all three sets of knuckles filthy, nobody breaking step. No uniforms, no helmets, no weapons anywhere in frame — only these three
shots.action: her arms go out and a hand closes over each of hers without anyone breaking step

shots.title: The rifles
shots.description: backlit silhouettes of soldiers at a tunnel mouth sighting down raised rifles into the dark, hard daylight blowing out behind them
shots.action: guards sight down their rifles

shots.title: She calls out
shots.description: a young woman plants herself between the blinding daylight and the small figure in the red cardigan behind her, both arms flung wide with palms turned out, mouth open mid-shout, head twisted into the glare, dust hanging in the shaft of light
shots.action: arms flung wide, she blocks the light from the small one in the red cardigan behind her

shots.title: The counting carries
shots.description: CU of a filthy red cardigan, its wearer walking steadily forward, lips moving, counting, daylight rising on her face, an adult hand closed around each of hers
shots.action: her counting carries up the tunnel

shots.title: They hear it
shots.description: soldiers at a tunnel mouth lowering their rifles, one turning his head to listen, hard daylight, dust
shots.action: the guards hold their fire

shots.title: The three of them, out into the light
shots.description: three figures walking out of a tunnel mouth into blown-out daylight, seen from behind: the red cardigan in the middle, a young woman in torn university layers on her left and the young man in the navy coat on her right, a hand still closed around each of hers and their three arms hanging linked as they go — and far back in the dark behind them a doorway standing shut. No uniforms, no helmets, no weapons, nobody else in the frame. Held to fade
shots.action: they walk out into daylight
